author: Clijmart
body:
Hey Avicers!

I'm really into making Avicus maps lately, but I'm running out of ideas.
If anyone of you got an awesome idea for me, please suggest them down below!

Please try to detail the idea as much as possible, and make sure to suggest original ideas.

Thanks a lot!
-Clijmart
